name: Lockheed L-1049H Super Constellation
summary: The triple-tailed piston airliner of the 1950s: four Wright Turbo Compound radials, a dolphin-curved fuselage and three fins to fit the hangars of the day. The H model carried passengers or freight; 53 were built.

takeoff.note: Approximate: rotation speed and ground roll for a mid-weight takeoff, Wright R-3350 takeoff rpm

verify.note: Standing on all three wheels with the oleos settled, the FlightGear model reaches 8.47 m at the fin tips against the published 7.54 m; length (with the long weather-radar nose) and span match within 0.3%, so the gap is in the height of the three fins.
